text_statements.quote: Our first year of trading, 2021, was closed through the RITC process at the end of 2023, on a year-of-account basis. The ultimate gross loss ratio is 36.2% with a very low incurred gross loss ratio of 10.9% (as at Q4 2024).
text_statements.test: With the 2023 report's 49.6% at end 2023, UW2021's GULR fell by 27% in 2024 on a closed year's (fixed) premium. As labelled: UW2021 66,053 -> 54,930 (-16.8%), direction agrees; implied premium 133.2m and 151.7m, both above the 111.9m floor. Transposed: 43,731 -> 57,359 (+31.2%), wrong direction; implied premium 88.2m at end 2023 (below the 111.9m written in calendar 2021 alone) and 158.5m at end 2024, a 79% premium rise in year four of a closed year.

text_statements.quote: The 2024 GAAP result produced an excellent 79.4% net combined ratio, driven by recognising a benign claims environment on prior years
text_statements.test: As labelled UW2021 falls 11,123 in 2024; transposed, no underwriting year falls (+13,628, +307, +52,121).

1609_2024.decisive_evidence: (1) UW2021 GULR 49.6% at end 2023 (2023 report p5) falling to 36.2% at end 2024 (2024 report p6): as labelled the UW2021 ultimate falls 66,053 -> 54,930; transposed it rises 43,731 -> 57,359, and 43,731 at 49.6% implies 88.2m premium, below the 111,910 GWP the syndicate wrote in 2021 (2022 report p7, all UW2021). (2) Retranslation ratios are near-constant within each underwriting year only under 2024-as-labelled paired with 2023-transposed and 2022-as-labelled. (3) The 2023 table is the odd one out: 2022 and 2024 tables share an orientation and the 2023 one is their mirror; the 2023 GULR test (66,700 transposed gives 134.5m premium; 44,451 as labelled gives 89.6m < 111.9m) independently confirms 2023 transposed, hence 2024 as labelled.
